thread:
Alex (PM): quick sync folks — need a tight launch checklist + rollback rules for the 8-partner pilot. goal: finalize by EOD Fri. thoughts? :calendar:
Nia (ProdOps): propose we narrow to 4 core signals so decisions are fast: 1) onboarding completion >= 75% within 7 days, 2) 95th perc API latency < 250ms, 3) zero P0s for 72h post-rollout, 4) partner satisfaction NPS >= 6/10.
Ben (Res): add a minimum sample threshold for quality signals: at least 50 unique sessions per partner before we mark the NPS as valid.
Priya (AE): partners asked for support-fee waivers + 2 months free credits as incentive. also suggest weekly 30m office hours to keep cadence. :thumbsup:
Elliot (Eng): technical rollback triggers I propose: if runtime exceptions / requests > 0.5% for a continuous 1h window OR token cost anomaly > 2x baseline for 30m -> auto-fallback to stable model-1.0 and open incident. also emit a public status notice.
Alex (PM): also want a prompt-regression gate: if our golden-prompt automated eval shows >5% drop vs baseline for two consecutive runs, pause rollout. make threshold tunable per partner.
Nia (ProdOps): agreed, thresholds should be per-partner because some do long-context scoring. i'll add an eval-toggle in dashboard.
Ben (Res): proposed short survey for partners (tag responses with partner id + active flags):
```
Q1: Did the system help you complete your task? (Y/N)
Q2: Ease of SDK integration (1-5)
Q3: Noted correctness failures? (short text)
Q4: Would you recommend this pilot? (1-10)
```
Alex (PM): good. also capture session id and feature flags for every feedback item.
Priya (AE): logistics: i'll draft the partner invite + incentive terms by Wed and include the weekly OH calendar. also suggest a short SLA paragraph explaining automated fallback so partners aren't surprised.
Elliot (Eng): include this line in that SLA: "Automated fallback to the stable model may occur; expected interruption typically <5m. For emergency bypass contact eng-oncall." i'll implement the fallback script by Thu EOD.
Nia (ProdOps): small question: what counts as onboarding completion?
Alex (PM): onboarding completion = partner has performed first successful /generate call and saved at least one response to their workspace. we'll record the exact event ids in the runbook.
Priya (AE): can we offer a $500 stipend per partner for time on feedback calls? small token helps secure attendance.
Ben (Res): yes and include compensated time for partner engineers if needed.
Elliot (Eng): flagging potential need for extra eng cycles; may pull from next sprint, will update tracker.
Alex (PM): action items: Priya -> draft messaging + incentives by Wed. Nia -> dashboard widgets + per-partner eval toggle by Thu. Elliot -> rollback monitors + fallback script by Thu EOD. Ben -> finalize survey + 3 interview scripts by Thu. I'll publish final criteria Fri AM.
LaunchBot: Reminder: this thread will be archived in 30 days unless pinned.
Nia (ProdOps): one more: sample-size gating on automated evals? some partners have low volume early on.
Ben (Res): set a minimum of 30 eval runs or 7 days whichever comes first, per partner.
Alex (PM): sounds fair. locking plan unless someone objects. i'll send the runbook and partner email Fri AM. :white_check_mark:
Priya (AE): no objections.
Elliot (Eng): ack.
Ben (Res): good to go.
Nia (ProdOps): good.
Alex (PM): thanks all, posting runbook link once live.
